title.raw: 卷十四 本紀第十四: 世祖十一 Volume 14 Annals 14: Shizu 11

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月戊辰朔，以皇太子故罷朝賀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, spring, first month, on the wuchen new moon, because of the crown prince court congratulations were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, on the wuchen new moon of the first month of spring, court congratulations were suspended because of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 禁賫金銀銅錢越海互市。

translations.literal: It was forbidden to carry gold, silver, and copper cash across the sea for mutual trade.
translations.idiomatic: Carrying gold, silver, and copper cash across the sea for trade was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，帝以日本孤遠島夷，重困民力，罷征日本，召阿八赤赴闕，仍散所顧民船。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the Emperor, because Japan was a solitary distant island barbarian state that heavily taxed the people's strength, halted the expedition against Japan, summoned Abaqchi to court, and likewise dispersed the civilian ships under his command.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Emperor halted the expedition against Japan, judging the country a solitary distant island state that had overtaxed the people's strength. He summoned Abaqchi to court and dispersed the civilian ships under his command.

sentences.zh: 以江南廢寺田土為人占據者，悉付總統楊璉真加修寺。

translations.literal: Land from abolished monasteries in Jiangnan that had been occupied by others was all transferred to chief controller Yang Lianzhenjia to repair monasteries.
translations.idiomatic: Land from abolished Jiangnan monasteries that others had seized was transferred to chief controller Yang Lianzhenjia to restore the monasteries.

sentences.zh: 己卯，立羅不、怯臺、阇鄽斡端等驛。

translations.literal: On jimao day post stations were established at Luobu, Qietai, Zheyang, and Woduan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day post stations were established at Luobu, Qietai, Zheyang, and Woduan.

sentences.zh: 呂文煥以江淮行省右丞告老，許之，任其子為宣慰使。

translations.literal: Lü Wenhuan, right associate of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat, requested retirement on grounds of age; this was granted, and his son was appointed pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Wenhuan, right associate of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat, requested retirement on grounds of age; the request was granted and his son was appointed pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，馬八國遣使進銅盾。

translations.literal: On gengchen day the kingdom of Ma-ba dispatched envoys presenting copper shields.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the kingdom of Ma-ba sent envoys presenting copper shields.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太陰犯軒轅太民。

translations.literal: On renwu day the moon encroached upon the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the moon encroached upon the great star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 遣使代祀嶽瀆東海。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice on the Emperor's behalf at the mountains, rivers, and Eastern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and Eastern Sea in the Emperor's stead.

sentences.zh: 癸未，罷鞏昌二十四城拘榷所，以其事入有司。

translations.literal: On guiwei day the twenty-four-city monopoly offices of Gongchang were abolished, and the matter was transferred to regular officials.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Gongchang's twenty-four-city monopoly offices were abolished and the work transferred to regular officials.

sentences.zh: 發鈔五千錠糴糧於沙、靜、隆興。

translations.literal: Five thousand ingots of paper currency were issued to purchase grain at Sha, Jing, and Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: 5,000 ingots of paper currency were issued to purchase grain at Sha, Jing, and Longxing.

sentences.zh: 從桑哥請，命楊璉真加遣宋宗戚謝儀孫、全允堅、趙沂、趙太一入質。

translations.literal: Following Sangge's request, Yang Lianzhenjia was ordered to send Song imperial clansmen Xie Yisun, Quan Yunjian, Zhao Yi, and Zhao Taiyi as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: At Sangge's request, Yang Lianzhenjia was ordered to send Song imperial clansmen Xie Yisun, Quan Yunjian, Zhao Yi, and Zhao Taiyi as hostages.

sentences.zh: 甲申，忽都魯言：「所部屯田新軍二百人，鑿河渠於亦集乃之地，役久功大，乞以傍近民、西僧余戶助其力。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Hudu'er said: "Two hundred newly submitted garrison-farming troops under my command have dug a canal at Yijinai; the labor has been long and the task vast; I ask that nearby civilians and surplus households of Western monks assist the work.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Hudu'er said, "Two hundred newly submitted garrison-farming troops under my command have dug a canal at Yijinai; the labor has been long and the task vast. I ask that nearby civilians and surplus households of Western monks assist."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 憨答孫遣使言：「軍士疲乏者八百餘人，乞賑贍，宜於朵魯朵海處驗其虛實。

translations.literal: Hansun dispatched envoys saying: "More than eight hundred exhausted soldiers ask for relief and provisioning; it would be appropriate to verify the truth at the Duoludu sea station.
translations.idiomatic: Hansun sent envoys saying, "More than 800 exhausted soldiers ask for relief and provisioning; their claims should be verified at the Duoludu sea station."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「比遣人往，事已緩矣，其使贍之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Sending men there recently would already have been too late; have them provisioned directly.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Sending men there now would already be too late; provision them directly."

sentences.zh: 」丁亥，焚陰陽偽書《顯明曆》。

translations.literal: " On dinghai day the spurious yin-yang book 《Manifest Brightness Calendar》 was burned.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the spurious yin-yang text 《Manifest Brightness Calendar》 was burned.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命阿裏海牙等議征安南事宜。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Ala Haiya and others were ordered to deliberate on matters related to the campaign against Annam.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Ala Haiya and others were ordered to deliberate on the campaign against Annam.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，升福州長溪縣為福寧州，以福安、寧德二縣隸之。

translations.literal: On guisi day Changxi County of Fuzhou was promoted to Ning Prefecture, with Fu'an and Ningde counties placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Changxi County of Fuzhou was promoted to Ning Prefecture, with Fu'an and Ningde counties placed under it.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以新附軍千人屯田合思罕關東曠地，官給農具牛種。

translations.literal: On bingshen day one thousand newly submitted troops were sent to garrison-farm the vacant lands east of Hesihan Pass; the government supplied farm implements and seed oxen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day 1,000 newly submitted troops were sent to garrison-farm vacant lands east of Hesihan Pass; the government supplied farm implements and seed oxen.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，畋於近郊。

translations.literal: On dingyou day the imperial carriage hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the imperial carriage hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 降敘州為縣，隸蠻夷宣撫司。

translations.literal: Xu Prefecture was reduced to a county and placed under the Man-Yi pacification commission.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Prefecture was reduced to a county and placed under the Man-Yi pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 詔禁沮擾鹽課。

translations.literal: An edict forbade interference with the salt tax.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade interference with the salt tax.

sentences.zh: 設諸路推官以審刑獄，上路二員，下路一員。

translations.literal: Review officials were established on all routes to examine criminal cases; two on upper routes, one on lower routes.
translations.idiomatic: Review officials were established on all routes to examine criminal cases: two on upper routes and one on lower routes.

sentences.zh: 升龍興武寧縣為寧州，以分寧隸之。

translations.literal: Wuning County of Longxing was promoted to Ning Prefecture, with Fenning placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: Wuning County of Longxing was promoted to Ning Prefecture, with Fenning placed under it.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，敕中外，凡漢民持鐵尺、手撾及杖之藏刃者，悉輸於官。

translations.literal: Second month, on jihai day, an edict was issued throughout court and countryside: all Han commoners possessing iron rules, hand maces, and staffs with hidden blades were to deliver them to the government.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai day, an edict ordered that throughout court and countryside all Han commoners possessing iron rules, hand maces, and staffs with hidden blades deliver them to the government.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣使以鈔五千錠賑諸王小薛所部饑民。

translations.literal: On xinchou day envoys were dispatched with five thousand ingots of paper currency to relieve the famine commoners under Prince Xiaoxue.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day envoys were sent with 5,000 ingots of paper currency to relieve famine commoners under Prince Xiaoxue.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以雪雪的斤為緬中行省左丞相，阿臺董阿參知政事，兀都迷失簽行中書省事。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Xuexuedejin was made left grand councillor of the Burma branch secretariat, Atai Dong'a associate administrator, and Udusmish secretary of branch secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Xuexuedejin was made left grand councillor of the Burma branch secretariat, Atai Dong'a associate administrator, and Udusmish secretary of branch secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 以阿裏海牙仍安南行中書省左丞相，奧魯赤平章政事，都元帥烏馬兒、亦裏迷失、阿裏、昝順、樊楫並參知政事。

translations.literal: Ala Haiya was retained as left grand councillor of the Annam branch secretariat; Orluchi grand councillor; commander-in-chief Umar, Yili Mish, Ali, Zanshun, and Fan Ji all associate administrators.
translations.idiomatic: Ala Haiya was retained as left grand councillor of the Annam branch secretariat; Orluchi was made grand councillor; and commander-in-chief Umar, Yili Mish, Ali, Zanshun, and Fan Ji were all made associate administrators.

sentences.zh: 遣使諭皇子也先鐵木兒，調合剌章軍千人或二三千，付阿裏海牙從征交趾，仍具將士姓名以聞。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to instruct Prince Yesen Temur to mobilize one or two or three thousand Helazhang troops and deliver them to Ala Haiya for the Jiaozhi campaign; the names of officers and soldiers were also to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to instruct Prince Yesen Temur to mobilize 1,000 to 3,000 Helazhang troops for Ala Haiya's Jiaozhi campaign and report the names of officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，廷議以東北諸王所部雜居其間，宣慰司望輕，罷山北遼東道、開元等路宣慰司，立東京等處行中書省，以闊闊你敦為左丞相，遼東道宣慰使塔出右丞，同簽樞密院事楊仁風、宣慰使亦而撒合並參知政事。

translations.literal: On yisi day court deliberation held that in the northeast, princes' domains were intermixed with others' populations and pacification commissions carried insufficient weight; the Shanbei Liaodong Circuit and Kaiyuan Route pacification commissions were abolished and the Eastern Capital branch secretariat was established, with Kuokkuonitudun as left grand councillor, Liaodong pacification commissioner Tachu as right associate, privy council secretary Yang Renfeng and pacification commissioner Yiersaghan as associate administrators.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the court decided that in the northeast princes' domains were intermixed with other populations and pacification commissions carried too little weight. The Shanbei Liaodong Circuit and Kaiyuan Route pacification commissions were abolished and the Eastern Capital branch secretariat established, with Kuokkuonitudun as left grand councillor, Liaodong pacification commissioner Tachu as right associate, and privy council secretary Yang Renfeng and pacification commissioner Yiersaghan as associate administrators.

sentences.zh: 敕中書省：「大府監所儲金銀，循先朝例分賜諸王。

translations.literal: An edict to the Central Secretariat said: "Gold and silver stored by the Palace Storehouse Directorate are to be distributed to princes according to former-court precedent.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the Central Secretariat said, "Gold and silver stored by the Palace Storehouse Directorate are to be distributed to princes according to former-court precedent."

sentences.zh: 」復立大司農司，專掌農桑。

translations.literal: " The Grand Agriculturist Directorate was re-established to manage exclusively agriculture and sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Agriculturist Directorate was re-established to manage agriculture and sericulture exclusively.

sentences.zh: 升宣徽院正二品，降鎮巢府為巢州。

translations.literal: The Imperial Provision Directorate was raised to rank two; Zhenchao Fu was reduced to Chao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Provision Directorate was raised to rank two, and Zhenchao Fu was reduced to Chao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，用御史臺臣言，立按察司巡行郡縣法，除使二員留司，副使以下每歲二月分蒞按治，十月還司。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, following censorate officials' memorial, regulations were established for surveillance commissioners touring counties; aside from two commissioners remaining at headquarters, deputy commissioners and below each year in the second month would proceed to inspect and govern and return to headquarters in the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, following censorate officials' memorial, regulations were established for surveillance commissioners touring counties: aside from two commissioners remaining at headquarters, deputy commissioners and below would each year in the second month proceed to inspect and govern and return in the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太陰犯井。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the moon encroached upon Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the moon encroached upon Jing.

sentences.zh: 戊申，樞密院奏：「前遣蒙古軍萬人屯田，所獲除歲費之外可糶鈔三千錠，乞分廩諸翼軍士之貧者。

translations.literal: On wushen day the Privy Council memorialized: "Previously dispatched ten thousand Mongol troops for garrison-farming obtained, beyond annual expenses, three thousand ingots of paper currency from grain sales; I ask that this be distributed from the granary to poor garrison troops in the various wings.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Privy Council memorialized, "Ten thousand Mongol troops previously dispatched for garrison-farming obtained, beyond annual expenses, 3,000 ingots of paper currency from grain sales; I ask that this be distributed from the granary to poor garrison troops in the various wings."

sentences.zh: 」帝悅，令從便行之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor was pleased and ordered it carried out as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was pleased and ordered it carried out as convenient.

sentences.zh: 調京師新附軍二千立營屯田。

translations.literal: Two thousand newly submitted troops of the capital were deployed in camps for garrison-farming.
translations.idiomatic: 2,000 newly submitted troops of the capital were deployed in camps for garrison-farming.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，復置隰州大寧縣。

translations.literal: On guichou day Daning County of Xi Prefecture was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Daning County of Xi Prefecture was re-established.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命湖廣行省造征交趾海船三百，期以八月會欽、廉州。

translations.literal: On dingsi day the Huguang branch secretariat was ordered to build three hundred sea vessels for the Jiaozhi campaign, to assemble at Qin and Lian prefectures in the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Huguang branch secretariat was ordered to build 300 sea vessels for the Jiaozhi campaign and assemble them at Qin and Lian prefectures in the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 戊午，並江南行樞密院四處入行省。

translations.literal: On wuwu day the four Jiangnan branch privy councils were merged into branch secretariats.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the four Jiangnan branch privy councils were merged into branch secretariats.

sentences.zh: 命荊湖占城行省將江浙、湖廣、江西三行省兵六萬人伐交趾。

translations.literal: The Jinghu-Zhancheng branch secretariat general was ordered to use sixty thousand troops from the Jiang-Zhe, Huguang, and Jiangxi branch secretariats to attack Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinghu-Zhancheng branch secretariat general was ordered to use 60,000 troops from the Jiang-Zhe, Huguang, and Jiangxi branch secretariats to attack Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 荊湖行省平章奧魯赤以征交趾事宜請入覲，詔乘傳赴闕。

translations.literal: Orluchi, grand councillor of the Jinghu branch secretariat, asked to come to audience regarding the Jiaozhi campaign; an edict ordered him to proceed to court by official courier.
translations.idiomatic: Orluchi, grand councillor of the Jinghu branch secretariat, asked to come to audience regarding the Jiaozhi campaign; an edict ordered him to proceed to court by official courier.

sentences.zh: 集賢直學士程文海言：「省院諸司皆以南人參用，惟御史臺按察司無之。

translations.literal: Academician-expositor Cheng Wenhai of the Hall of Worthies said: "Provincial secretariat bureaus and agencies all employ southerners jointly, but the censorate and surveillance commissions do not.
translations.idiomatic: Academician-expositor Cheng Wenhai of the Hall of Worthies said, "Provincial secretariat bureaus and agencies all employ southerners jointly, but the censorate and surveillance commissions do not."

sentences.zh: 江南風俗，南人所諳，宜參用之便。

translations.literal: Southern custom is what southerners know; it would be convenient to employ them jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Southern custom is what southerners know; it would be convenient to employ them jointly.

sentences.zh: 」帝以語玉速鐵木兒，對曰：「當擇賢者以聞。

translations.literal: " The Emperor spoke of this to Yusutemur, who replied: "Capable men should be selected and reported.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor spoke of this to Yusutemur, who replied, "Capable men should be selected and reported."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「汝漢人用事者，豈皆賢邪？

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Are all Han officials you employ necessarily capable?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Are all Han officials you employ necessarily capable?"

sentences.zh: 」江南諸路學田昔皆隸官，詔復給本學，以便教養。

translations.literal: " School lands on Jiangnan routes had formerly all been placed under the government; an edict restored them to the original schools to facilitate teaching and nurture.
translations.idiomatic: School lands on Jiangnan routes had formerly all been placed under the government; an edict restored them to the original schools to facilitate teaching and nurture.

sentences.zh: 封陳益稷為安南王，陳秀爰為輔義公，仍下詔諭安南吏民。

translations.literal: Chen Yiji was enfeoffed as king of Annam and Chen Xiuyuan as Duke of Assisting Righteousness; an edict was also issued instructing Annam officials and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yiji was enfeoffed as king of Annam and Chen Xiuyuan as Duke of Assisting Righteousness; an edict was also issued instructing Annam officials and commoners.

sentences.zh: 復立嶽、鄂、常德、潭州、靜江榷茶提舉司。

translations.literal: The Yue, E, Changde, Tanzhou, and Jingjiang tea monopoly offices were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: The Yue, E, Changde, Tanzhou, and Jingjiang tea monopoly offices were re-established.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太史院上《授時曆經》、《曆議》，敕藏於翰林國史院。

translations.literal: On guihai day the Astronomical Observatory submitted the 《Calendar Canon of the Shou Shi Era》 and 《Calendrical Discourse》; an edict ordered them stored in the Hanlin Imperial Historiography Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Astronomical Observatory submitted the 《Calendar Canon of the Shou Shi Era》 and 《Calendrical Discourse》; an edict ordered them stored in the Hanlin Imperial Historiography Academy.

sentences.zh: 甲子，復以平原郡公趙與芮江南田隸東宮，立甘州行中書省。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Plains Prefecture duke Zhao Yourui's Jiangnan land was again placed under the Eastern Palace, and the Ganzhou branch secretariat was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Plains Prefecture duke Zhao Yourui's Jiangnan land was again placed under the Eastern Palace, and the Ganzhou branch secretariat was established.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以編地裏書，召曲阜教授陳儼、京兆蕭、蜀人虞應龍，唯應龍赴京師。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, for compiling land registers, Qufu professor Chen Yan, Jingzhao's Xiao, and Yu Yinglong of Shu were summoned; only Yinglong came to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, to compile land registers, Qufu professor Chen Yan, Jingzhao's Xiao, and Yu Yinglong of Shu were summoned; only Yinglong came to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，御史臺臣言：「近奉旨按察司參用南人，非臣等所知，宜令侍御史、行御史臺事程文海與行臺官博采公潔知名之士，具以名聞。

translations.literal: Third month, on jisi day, censorate officials said: "Recently, following an imperial order, surveillance commissions were to employ southerners jointly, which is not within our knowledge; attendant censor Cheng Wenhai, handling branch censorate affairs, should together with branch censorate officials broadly gather reputable men of public integrity and report their names.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jisi day, censorate officials said, "Recently, following an imperial order, surveillance commissions were to employ southerners jointly, which is not within our knowledge; attendant censor Cheng Wenhai, handling branch censorate affairs, should together with branch censorate officials broadly gather reputable men of public integrity and report their names."

sentences.zh: 」帝命賫詔以往。

translations.literal: " The Emperor ordered an edict sent forth.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered an edict sent forth.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯婁。

translations.literal: The moon encroached upon Lou.
translations.idiomatic: The moon encroached upon Lou.

sentences.zh: 浚治中興路河渠。

translations.literal: The Zhongxing Route canals were dredged and repaired.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhongxing Route canals were dredged and repaired.

sentences.zh: 省雲和署入教坊司。

translations.literal: The Yunhe Office was merged into the Music Office.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunhe Office was merged into the Music Office.

sentences.zh: 辛未，降梅、循為下州。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Mei and Xun were reduced to lower prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Mei and Xun were reduced to lower prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，雄、霸二州及保定諸縣水泛溢，冒官民田，發軍民築河堤禦之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Xiong, Ba, and the counties of Baoding were flooded, inundating official and private fields; troops and civilians were mobilized to build river dikes for defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Xiong, Ba, and the counties of Baoding were flooded, inundating official and private fields; troops and civilians were mobilized to build river dikes.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以麥術丁仍中書右丞，與郭佑並領錢谷，楊居寬典銓選。

translations.literal: On yihai day Maishuding was retained as right associate of the Central Secretariat; he and Guo You jointly managed revenue and grain; Yang Jukuan handled appointments.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Maishuding was retained as right associate of the Central Secretariat; he and Guo You jointly managed revenue and grain, and Yang Jukuan handled appointments.

sentences.zh: 立欽察衛親軍都指揮使司。

translations.literal: The Qipchaq Imperial Guard Command was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Qipchaq Imperial Guard Command was established.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王脫忽帖木兒羊二萬。

translations.literal: Prince Tuhu Temur was granted twenty thousand sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Tuhu Temur was granted 20,000 sheep.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 詔行御史臺按察司以八月巡行郡縣。

translations.idiomatic: Ma-Fa sent saddles and harness and felt armor.

translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade hunting while beasts and birds were breeding.

translations.idiomatic: Abachi was appointed right associate of the Champa campaign branch secretariat.

translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, because Liangxiang and Baodi counties in Zhuo and Yi prefectures suffered famine, this year's land tax was remitted and three months' grain issued.

translations.idiomatic: Pingluan, Taiyuan, and Bianliang suffered flood and drought disasters, and 25,600-odd shi of civilian land tax was remitted.

translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong transport maritime trade intendant bureau was changed to the salt levy maritime trade intendant bureau.

translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Tachar and Hunan were ordered to proceed to Arhun.

translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day envoys were sent to verify famine victims in Xuanning County and provide relief.

translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the moon transgressed the Well.

translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Jupiter transgressed Leibi Formation.

translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yiwei day: Kaiyuan in Liaodong suffered famine, and grain was distributed for three months.

translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Venus transgressed Dongxian.

translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Yeshi Mu registered Ali Haiya's household property and had it transported to the capital.

translations.idiomatic: Prince Shibo's 5,000 troops were given 15,000 liang of silver and 3,000 ingots of notes; 2,000 tammaq were given 70,000 sheep.

translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the moon transgressed the Well.

translations.idiomatic: One thousand masterless fugitive commoners sheltered by Ali Haiya were put to garrison-farming.

translations.idiomatic: The Quanzhou maritime trade intendant bureau was reestablished.

translations.idiomatic: The capital suffered famine; official grain was sold at reduced price to the poor.

translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day poor Puchang clients were sent to reclaim idle land in Gansu; the government provided oxen, seed, and farm implements.

translations.idiomatic: King Chen Yiji of Annam was given sheep, horses, and 100 ingots of notes.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the moon transgressed Di.

translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Hanlin academician Sariman said, "The dynastic history academy is compiling veritable records of successive reigns from Taizu; we ask to translate them into Uighur script and only then finalize after presentation and reading.

translations.idiomatic: Each circuit was divided to establish six agricultural encouragement commissions.

translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the precious tribute bureau was established in Jining and other circuits, rank 5b.

translations.idiomatic: That year Yeshi Silinzhen was appointed imperial preceptor.

translations.idiomatic: Princes Aoluchi, Tuohuan, Shibo, Yebogan, and others were given 151,923 ingots of notes for sheep and horses, 7,290 horses, 36,269 sheep, 3,288 bolts of silk, felt, and cotton cloth, and 14 sable furs.

translations.idiomatic: Prince Tuohuan's dependent Lianyasibuhua and others and craftsmen of various bureaus in Qian Prefecture were also given 56,139 ingots and 12 liang of notes.

translations.idiomatic: Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites in succession at Wanshou Mountain, Jade Pagoda Hall, and Wan'an Monastery, 30 sessions in all.

translations.idiomatic: The grand secretariat for agriculture reported 20,166 schools in all circuits, 90,535 shi of stored charity grain, and 23,094,672 mulberry, jujube, and various fruit trees planted.

translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, on yichou day of the first month of spring, Shiliang County in Yunnan was restored.

translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day 3,000 southern troops were used to build dikes on the Liulin River and dredge the canal at Hexiwu.

translations.idiomatic: Prince Aoluchi's dependent households suffered famine; Datong Circuit was ordered to provide 60 days' grain.

translations.idiomatic: One thousand newly submitted troops were dispatched to follow Abachi against Annam.

translations.idiomatic: The Jiang-Zhe province was again changed to the Jianghuai branch secretariat.

translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day 10,000 ingots of notes were used to relieve the poor of Woduan.

translations.idiomatic: The upper forest bureau was established, rank 7b.

translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

translations.idiomatic: Fan Wenhu was made right councillor of the central secretariat and consulted on privy council affairs.

translations.idiomatic: On renzi day imperial son-in-law Changji was enfeoffed as Prince of Ningpu Commandery.

translations.idiomatic: A metropolitan general administration commission was established to oversee the Northern Pacification Prince's artisans and large and small revenues of Woduan.

translations.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "From New Year's to mid-second month five hundred thousand ingots of notes were spent; we jointly oversee revenues; from now on when attendants memorialize requesting grants, we ask to be allowed to deliberate first.
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said, "From New Year's to mid-second month 500,000 ingots of notes were spent; we jointly oversee revenues; from now on when attendants memorialize requesting grants, we ask to be allowed to deliberate first.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「此朕所常慮。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "This is what I always worry about.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "This is what I always worry about.

sentences.zh: 」仍諭玉速鐵木兒、月赤徹兒知之。

translations.literal: " He also instructed Yisutiemuer and Yuechiche to be informed.
translations.idiomatic: " He also instructed Yisutiemuer and Yuechiche to be informed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，馬八兒國貢方物。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Ma Ba'er sent tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Ma Ba'er sent tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 戊午，敕諸王阇裏鐵木兒節制諸軍。

translations.literal: On wuwu day an edict ordered Prince Chalithemur to command all armies.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict ordered Prince Chalithemur to command all armies.

sentences.zh: 以趙與芮子孟桂襲平原郡公。

translations.literal: Zhao Yourui's son Menggui inherited the title Duke of Pingyuan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yourui's son Menggui inherited the title Duke of Pingyuan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 乃顏遣使征東道兵，阇諭裏鐵木兒毋輒發。

translations.literal: Nayan sent envoys to levy Eastern Route troops; Chalithemur was instructed not to mobilize rashly.
translations.idiomatic: Nayan sent envoys to levy Eastern Route troops; Chalithemur was instructed not to mobilize rashly.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸亥，太陰犯辰星。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, guihai day: the moon transgressed Mercury.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, guihai day: the moon transgressed Mercury.

sentences.zh: 以女直、水達達部連歲饑荒，移粟賑之，仍盡免今年公賦及減所輸皮布之半。

translations.literal: Because Jurchen and Shui Dada tribes had famine year after year, grain was transferred to relieve them, and this year's public levies were fully remitted and half the fur-cloth tribute reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Because Jurchen and Shui Dada tribes had famine year after year, grain was transferred to relieve them, and this year's public levies were fully remitted and half the fur-cloth tribute reduced.

sentences.zh: 以宋畬軍將校授管民官，散之郡邑。

translations.literal: Song colonized-army officers were appointed civilian officials and dispersed to counties and prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Song colonized-army officers were appointed civilian officials and dispersed to counties and prefectures.

sentences.zh: 敕春秋二仲月上丙日祀堯帝祠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered sacrifice at Emperor Yao's shrine on bing days of the second months of spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered sacrifice at Emperor Yao's shrine on bing days of the second months of spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 西京等處管課官馬合謀自言歲以西京、平陽、太原課程額外羨錢市馬駝千輸官，而實盜官錢市之，按問有跡，伏誅。

translations.literal: Officials managing levied horses in Xijing and elsewhere conspired, claiming each year to use surplus revenue from Xijing, Pingyang, and Taiyuan beyond quotas to buy one thousand horses and camels for the government, but actually embezzled government funds for the purchases; investigation found evidence and they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Officials managing levied horses in Xijing and elsewhere conspired, claiming each year to use surplus revenue from Xijing, Pingyang, and Taiyuan beyond quotas to buy 1,000 horses and camels for the government, but actually embezzled government funds for the purchases; investigation found evidence and they were executed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，畋於近郊。

translations.literal: On yichou day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 召麥術丁、鐵木兒、楊居寬等與集賢大學士阿魯渾撒裏及葉李、程文海、趙孟頫論鈔法。

translations.literal: Maishuding, Tiemuer, Yang Jukuan, and others were summoned together with Hanlin academician Aruqinsaili and Ye Li, Cheng Wenhai, and Zhao Mengfu to discuss paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: Maishuding, Tiemuer, Yang Jukuan, and others were summoned together with Hanlin academician Aruqinsaili and Ye Li, Cheng Wenhai, and Zhao Mengfu to discuss paper currency.

sentences.zh: 麥術丁言：「自制國用使司改尚書省，頗有成效，今仍分兩省為便。

translations.literal: Maishuding said: "Since changing the State Revenue Bureau to the Ministry secretariat has been quite effective, it would now be better to split the two secretariats again.
translations.idiomatic: Maishuding said, "Since changing the state revenue bureau to the ministry secretariat has been quite effective, it would now be better to split the two secretariats again.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之，各設官六員。

translations.literal: An edict approved this; six officials were appointed to each.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved this, and six officials were appointed to each.

sentences.zh: 其尚書，以桑哥、鐵木兒平章政事，阿魯渾撒裏右丞，葉李左丞，馬紹參知政事，余一員議選回回人充；

translations.literal: For the Ministry [secretariat], Sangge and Tiemuer were made grand councillors, Aruqinsaili right vice chancellor, Ye Li left vice chancellor, and Ma Shao associate administrator; the remaining one post was to be filled through deliberation by a Muslim.
translations.idiomatic: For the ministry secretariat, Sangge and Tiemuer were made grand councillors, Aruqinsaili right vice chancellor, Ye Li left vice chancellor, and Ma Shao associate administrator; the remaining post was to be filled through deliberation by a Muslim.

sentences.zh: 中書，宜設丞相二員、平章政事二員、參知政事二員。

translations.literal: For the Central Secretariat, there should be two chancellors, two grand councillors, and two associate administrators.
translations.idiomatic: For the central secretariat, there should be two chancellors, two grand councillors, and two associate administrators.

sentences.zh: 省隴右河西道提刑按察司，分置鞏昌者入甘州，設官五員；

translations.literal: The Longyou Hexi Circuit Surveillance Commission was abolished; the branch set at Gongchang was merged into Ganzhou, with five officials appointed.
translations.idiomatic: The Longyou Hexi circuit surveillance commission was abolished; the branch set at Gongchang was merged into Ganzhou, with five officials appointed.

sentences.zh: 以鞏昌改隸京兆提刑按察司，設官六員；

translations.literal: Gongchang was transferred to the Jingzhao Surveillance Commission, with six officials appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchang was transferred to the Jingzhao surveillance commission, with six officials appointed.

sentences.zh: 省太原提刑按察司，分置西京者入太原。

translations.literal: The Taiyuan Surveillance Commission was abolished; the branch set at Xijing was merged into Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiyuan surveillance commission was abolished; the branch set at Xijing was merged into Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以復置尚書省詔天下。

translations.literal: On xinwei day an edict announcing the re-establishment of the Ministry secretariat was sent throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day an edict announcing the re-establishment of the ministry secretariat was sent throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 除行省與中書議行，余並聽尚書省從便以聞。

translations.literal: Except that branch secretariats would deliberate with the Central Secretariat before acting, all other matters were left to the Ministry secretariat to handle as convenient and report.
translations.idiomatic: Except that branch secretariats would deliberate with the central secretariat before acting, all other matters were left to the ministry secretariat to handle as convenient and report.

sentences.zh: 設國子監，立國學監官：祭酒一員，司業二員，監丞一員，學官博士二員，助教四員，生員百二十人，蒙古、漢人各半，官給紙劄、飲食，仍隸集賢院。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Education was established, with directorate officials appointed: one director, two vice-directors, one supervising secretary, two academic doctors, four teaching assistants, and one hundred twenty students, half Mongol and half Han, with paper currency and food supplied by the state; it remained under the Academy of Scholarly Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate of education was established, with one director, two vice-directors, one supervising secretary, two academic doctors, four teaching assistants, and 120 students, half Mongol and half Han, with paper currency and food supplied by the state; it remained under the Academy of Scholarly Worthies.

sentences.zh: 設江南各道儒學提舉司。

translations.literal: Confucian education intendant offices were established in each Jiangnan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Confucian education intendant offices were established in each Jiangnan circuit.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太陰犯牽牛。

translations.literal: On jiashen day the moon transgressed Niulang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the moon transgressed Niulang.

sentences.zh: 車駕還宮。

translations.literal: The imperial procession returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial procession returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，改淄萊路為般陽路，置錄事司。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Zilai Route was renamed Panyang Route and a records office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Zilai Route was renamed Panyang Route and a records office was established.

sentences.zh: 大都饑，免今歲銀俸鈔，諸路半征之。

translations.literal: Famine in Dadu; this year's silver salary notes were remitted, while the various routes collected half.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in Dadu; this year's silver salary notes were remitted, while the various routes collected half.

sentences.zh: 罷江南竹木柴薪及岸例魚牙諸課，停不給之務。

translations.literal: Taxes on Jiangnan bamboo, timber, firewood, and fish-market duties were abolished, and unpaid services were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes on Jiangnan bamboo, timber, firewood, and fish-market duties were abolished, and unpaid services were suspended.

sentences.zh: 敕行省宣慰司勿濫舉官吏，受除官延引歲月不即之任者，追所受宣敕。

translations.literal: An order directed branch secretariat and pacification commission offices not to recommend officials recklessly; those who had received appointments but delayed taking office for months were to have their appointment documents revoked.
translations.idiomatic: An order directed branch secretariat and pacification commission offices not to recommend officials recklessly; those who had received appointments but delayed taking office for months were to have their appointment documents revoked.

sentences.zh: 鎮南王脫歡徙鎮南京。

translations.literal: Prince of Zhennan Tuohuan was transferred to guard Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Zhennan Tuohuan was transferred to guard Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 改福建市舶都漕運司為都轉運鹽使司。

translations.literal: The Fujian Maritime Trade and Transport Commission was renamed the Salt Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian maritime trade and transport commission was renamed the salt transport commission.

sentences.zh: 範文虎改尚書右丞，商議樞密院事。

translations.literal: Fan Wenhu was made right vice chancellor of the Ministry secretariat to deliberate on Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Wenhu was made right vice chancellor of the ministry secretariat to deliberate on privy council affairs.

sentences.zh: 改行中書省為行尚書省，六部為尚書六部，以吏部尚書忻都為尚書省參知政事。

translations.literal: The Branch Central Secretariat was renamed the Branch Ministry secretariat; the Six Ministries became the Six Ministries of Revenue; Xindu, Minister of Personnel, was made associate administrator of the Ministry secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The branch central secretariat was renamed the branch ministry secretariat; the six ministries became the six ministries of revenue; Xindu, minister of personnel, was made associate administrator of the ministry secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the imperial procession proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the imperial procession proceeded to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 劄魯忽赤合剌合孫等言：「去歲審囚官所錄囚數，南京、濟南兩路應死者已一百九十人，若總校諸路，為數必多，宜留劄魯忽赤數人分道行刑。

translations.literal: Jalhuqa Helegesun and others said: "Last year the judicial review officials recorded prisoners; in Nanjing and Jinan circuits alone those deserving death already numbered one hundred ninety; if all routes were checked, the total would surely be large — Jalhuqa and several others should be retained to carry out executions in separate districts.
translations.idiomatic: Jalhuqa Helegesun and others said, "Last year the judicial review officials recorded prisoners; in Nanjing and Jinan circuits alone those deserving death already numbered 190; if all routes were checked, the total would surely be large — Jalhuqa and several others should be retained to carry out executions in separate districts.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「囚非群羊，豈可遽殺耶？

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Prisoners are not a flock of sheep — how can they be killed in haste?
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Prisoners are not a flock of sheep — how can they be killed in haste?

sentences.zh: 宜悉配隸淘金。」

translations.literal: All should be assigned to gold-panning labor."
translations.idiomatic: All should be assigned to gold-panning labor."

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，更造至元寶鈔頒行天下，中統鈔通行如故。

translations.literal: Third month, jiawu day: new Zhiyuan treasure notes were minted and issued throughout the realm; Zhongtong notes continued to circulate as before.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiawu day: new Zhiyuan treasure notes were minted and issued throughout the realm; Zhongtong notes continued to circulate as before.

sentences.zh: 以至元寶鈔一貫文當中統交鈔五貫文，子母相權，要在新者無冗，舊者無廢。

translations.literal: One string of Zhiyuan treasure notes equaled five strings of Zhongtong exchange notes; parent and child notes were mutually balanced, the aim being that the new would not be excessive and the old would not be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: One string of Zhiyuan treasure notes equaled five strings of Zhongtong exchange notes; parent and child notes were mutually balanced, the aim being that the new would not be excessive and the old would not be abolished.

sentences.zh: 凡歲賜、周乏、餉軍，皆以中統鈔為準。

translations.literal: All annual grants, relief for the needy, and military provisions were reckoned in Zhongtong notes as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: All annual grants, relief for the needy, and military provisions were reckoned in Zhongtong notes as the standard.

sentences.zh: 禁無籍自效軍擾民，仍籍充軍。

translations.literal: Unregistered men who volunteered for military service and harassed civilians were forbidden; they were enrolled as garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Unregistered men who volunteered for military service and harassed civilians were forbidden; they were enrolled as garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太陰犯東井。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幸涼陘。

translations.literal: On yimao day the Emperor visited Liang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Emperor visited Liang Pass.

sentences.zh: 遼東饑，弛太子河捕魚禁。

translations.literal: Famine in Liaodong; the ban on fishing in the Taizi River was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in Liaodong; the ban on fishing in the Taizi River was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，馬八兒國遣使進奇獸一，類騾而巨，毛黑白間錯，名阿塔必即。

translations.literal: On bingchen day the kingdom of Ma Ba'er sent envoys presenting one strange beast, resembling a mule but huge, with black and white intermingled fur, named Atabij.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the kingdom of Ma Ba'er sent envoys presenting one strange beast, resembling a mule but huge, with black and white intermingled fur, named Atabij.

sentences.zh: 降重慶路定遠州為縣。

translations.literal: Dingyuan Prefecture in Chongqing Route was downgraded to a county.
translations.idiomatic: Dingyuan Prefecture in Chongqing Route was downgraded to a county.

sentences.zh: 命都水監開汶、泗水以達京師。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Waterways was ordered to open the Wen and Si rivers to reach the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate of waterways was ordered to open the Wen and Si rivers to reach the capital.

sentences.zh: 汴梁河水泛溢，役夫七千修完故堤。

translations.literal: The Bianliang river flooded; seven thousand laborers repaired the old embankments.
translations.idiomatic: The Bianliang river flooded; 7,000 laborers repaired the old embankments.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，太陰犯氐。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guiyou day: the moon transgressed Di.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, guiyou day: the moon transgressed Di.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太陰犯房。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed Fang.

sentences.zh: 甲申，忻都奏發新鈔十一萬六百錠、銀千五百九十三錠、金百兩，付江南各省與民互市。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Xindu memorialized dispatching one hundred ten thousand six hundred ingots of new notes, one thousand five hundred ninety-three ingots of silver, and one hundred taels of gold to the Jiangnan branch secretariats for mutual trade with the people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Xindu memorialized dispatching 110,600 ingots of new notes, 1,593 ingots of silver, and 100 taels of gold to the Jiangnan branch secretariats for mutual trade with the people.

sentences.zh: 是月，諸王乃顏反。

translations.literal: That month Prince Nayan rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That month Prince Nayan rebelled.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，遣也先傳旨諭北京等處宣慰司，凡隸乃顏所部者禁其往來，毋令乘馬持弓矢。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jihai day: Yexian was dispatched with an imperial message to the Beijing and other pacification commissions: all subjects under Nayan's jurisdiction were forbidden to travel back and forth, nor permitted to ride horses or carry bows and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jihai day: Yexian was dispatched with an imperial message to the Beijing and other pacification commissions; all subjects under Nayan's jurisdiction were forbidden to travel back and forth, nor permitted to ride horses or carry bows and arrows.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以不魯合罕總探馬赤軍三千人出征。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Bulughan was placed in overall command of three thousand tammaq for the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Bulughan was placed in overall command of 3,000 tammaq for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 移濟南宣慰司治益都，燕南按察司治大名，南京按察司治南陽，太原按察司治西京，復立豐州亦剌真站。

translations.literal: The Jinan Pacification Commission moved its seat to Yidu; the Yannan Surveillance Commission to Daming; the Nanjing Surveillance Commission to Nanyang; the Taiyuan Surveillance Commission to Xijing; and Fengzhou Yilaizhen relay station was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinan pacification commission moved its seat to Yidu; the Yannan surveillance commission to Daming; the Nanjing surveillance commission to Nanyang; the Taiyuan surveillance commission to Xijing; and Fengzhou Yilaizhen relay station was re-established.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以御史臺吏王良弼等誹訕尚書省政事，誅良弼，籍其家，餘皆斷罪。

translations.literal: On renyin day, because censorate clerk Wang Liangbi and others had slandered Ministry secretariat policies, Liangbi was executed, his property confiscated, and the rest all sentenced.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, because censorate clerk Wang Liangbi and others had slandered ministry secretariat policies, Liangbi was executed, his property confiscated, and the rest all sentenced.

sentences.zh: 用桑哥言，置上海、福州兩萬戶府，以維制沙不丁、烏馬兒等海運船。

translations.literal: Following Sangge's recommendation, Shanghai and Fuzhou myriarch offices were established to restrain Shabudin, Umar, and others' sea-transport ships.
translations.idiomatic: Following Sangge's recommendation, Shanghai and Fuzhou myriarch offices were established to restrain Shabudin, Umar, and others' sea-transport ships.

sentences.zh: 戶、工兩部各增尚書二員。

translations.literal: Two additional ministers were added to each of the Ministries of Revenue and Works.
translations.idiomatic: Two additional ministers were added to each of the ministries of revenue and works.

sentences.zh: 授高麗王春行尚書省平章政事。

translations.literal: King Wang Chun of Goryeo was granted Branch Ministry secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo was granted branch ministry secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 罷諸路站脫脫禾孫。

translations.literal: Relay-station toqtoghusun on various routes were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Relay-station toqtoghusun on various routes were abolished.

sentences.zh: 括江南諸路匠戶。

translations.literal: Artisan households in the Jiangnan routes were registered.
translations.idiomatic: Artisan households in the Jiangnan routes were registered.

sentences.zh: 沙不丁言：「江南各省南官多，每省宜用一二人。

translations.literal: Shabudin said: "Southern officials in Jiangnan branch secretariats are numerous; each province should use one or two.
translations.idiomatic: Shabudin said, "Southern officials in Jiangnan branch secretariats are numerous; each province should use one or two.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「除陳巖、呂師夔、管如德、範文虎四人，余從卿議。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Except for the four men Chen Yan, Lü Shiyao, Guan Rude, and Fan Wenhu, the rest follow your recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Except for the four men Chen Yan, Lü Shiyao, Guan Rude, and Fan Wenhu, the rest follow your recommendation.

sentences.zh: 」帝自將征乃顏，發上都。

translations.literal: " The Emperor personally led the campaign against Nayan, departing from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor personally led the campaign against Nayan, departing from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 括江南僧道馬匹。

translations.literal: Horses of Buddhist and Daoist clergy in Jiangnan were registered.
translations.idiomatic: Horses of Buddhist and Daoist clergy in Jiangnan were registered.

sentences.zh: 詔範文虎將衛軍五百鎮平灤，以欽察為親軍都指揮使，也速帶兒、右衛僉事王通副之。

translations.literal: An edict directed Fan Wenhu to garrison Pingluan with five hundred imperial guard troops; Qincha was made chief commander of the personal guard army, with Yesudai'er and Right Guard deputy Wang Tong as his deputies.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed Fan Wenhu to garrison Pingluan with 500 imperial guard troops; Qincha was made chief commander of the personal guard army, with Yesudai'er and Right Guard deputy Wang Tong as his deputies.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，免北京今歲絲銀，仍以軍旅經行，給鈔三千錠賑之。

translations.literal: On jiachen day this year's silk and silver taxes in Beijing were remitted, and because troops had passed through, three thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day this year's silk and silver taxes in Beijing were remitted, and because troops had passed through, 3,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，高麗王春請益兵征乃顏，以五百人赴之。

translations.literal: On renzi day King Wang Chun of Goryeo requested additional troops for the campaign against Nayan; five hundred men were sent.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day King Wang Chun of Goryeo requested additional troops for the campaign against Nayan; 500 men were sent.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申朔，百官以職守不得從征乃顏，願獻馬以給衛士。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengshen new moon: officials who could not join the campaign against Nayan because of their duties wished to present horses to supply the guards.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengshen new moon: officials who could not join the campaign against Nayan because of their duties wished to present horses to supply the guards.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，至撒兒都魯之地。

translations.literal: On renxu day the army reached Sa'erdu'lu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the army reached Sa'erdu'lu.

sentences.zh: 乃顏黨塔不帶率所部六萬逼行在而陣，遣前軍敗之。

translations.literal: Nayan's partisan Tabudai led his force of sixty thousand to approach the imperial camp and form battle lines; advance troops were sent and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Nayan's partisan Tabudai led his force of 60,000 to approach the imperial camp and form battle lines; advance troops were sent and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，敕遼陽省督運軍儲。

translations.literal: On yichou day Liaoyang Province was ordered to supervise transport of military provisions.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Liaoyang Province was ordered to supervise transport of military provisions.

sentences.zh: 壬申，發諸衛軍萬人、蒙古軍千人戍豪、懿州。

translations.literal: On renshen day ten thousand guard troops and one thousand Mongol troops were dispatched to garrison Hao and Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day 10,000 guard troops and 1,000 Mongol troops were dispatched to garrison Hao and Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 諸王失都兒所部鐵哥率其黨取咸平府，渡遼，欲劫取豪、懿州，守臣以乏軍求援，敕以北京戍軍千人赴之。

translations.literal: Prince Shetu'er's follower Tiege led his partisans to seize Xianping Prefecture, crossed the Liao River, and intended to plunder Hao and Yizhou; the defending officials, lacking troops, sought aid, and an edict sent one thousand Beijing garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Shetu'er's follower Tiege led his partisans to seize Xianping Prefecture, crossed the Liao River, and intended to plunder Hao and Yizhou; the defending officials, lacking troops, sought aid, and an edict sent 1,000 Beijing garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 括平灤路馬。

translations.literal: Horses in Pingluan Route were registered.
translations.idiomatic: Horses in Pingluan Route were registered.

sentences.zh: 北京饑，免絲銀、租稅。

translations.literal: Famine in Beijing; silk, silver, and land taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in Beijing; silk, silver, and land taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，霸州益津縣霖雨傷稼。

translations.literal: On yihai day heavy rain damaged crops in Yijin County, Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day heavy rain damaged crops in Yijin County, Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 以陜西涇、邠、乾及安西屬縣閑田立屯田總管府，置官屬，秩三品。

translations.literal: Using idle land in Jing, Bin, and Qian prefectures of Shaanxi and counties subordinate to Anxi, a military colony commission was established with a staff of third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Using idle land in Jing, Bin, and Qian prefectures of Shaanxi and counties subordinate to Anxi, a military colony commission was established with a staff of third rank.

sentences.zh: 車駕駐幹大利斡魯脫之地，獲乃顏輜重千餘，仍禁秋毫無犯。

translations.literal: The imperial procession encamped at Gandali Woluotuo; more than one thousand of Nayan's supply wagons were captured, while strict orders forbade the slightest violation.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial procession encamped at Gandali Woluotuo; more than 1,000 of Nayan's supply wagons were captured, while strict orders forbade the slightest violation.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，乃顏黨失都兒犯咸平，宣慰塔出從皇子愛牙赤，合兵出沈州進討，宣慰亦兒撒合分兵趣懿州，其黨悉平。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, guisi day: Nayan's partisan Shetu'er invaded Xianping; pacification commissioner Tacu followed Prince Aiyachi, combined forces, and advanced from Shenzhou to attack; pacification commissioner Yiersahe divided troops toward Yizhou; their partisans were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, guisi day: Nayan's partisan Shetu'er invaded Xianping; pacification commissioner Tacu followed Prince Aiyachi, combined forces, and advanced from Shenzhou to attack; pacification commissioner Yiersahe divided troops toward Yizhou; their partisans were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，弘州匠官以犬兔毛制如西錦者以獻，授匠官知弘州。

translations.literal: On dingyou day an artisan official of Hongzhou presented fabric like Western brocade made from dog and rabbit fur, and was appointed artisan official and prefect of Hongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day an artisan official of Hongzhou presented fabric like Western brocade made from dog and rabbit fur, and was appointed artisan official and prefect of Hongzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: On wuxu day the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 樞密院奏：「簽征緬行省事合撒兒海牙言，比至緬國，諭其王赴闕，彼言鄰番數叛，未易即行，擬遣阿難答剌奉表賫土貢入覲。

translations.literal: The Privy Council memorialized: "Acting Burma expedition branch secretariat commissioner Hesairihaiya reported that on reaching Burma, when he urged the king to come to court, the king said neighboring tribes had repeatedly rebelled and it was not easy to depart immediately; it was proposed to send Anadara to present a memorial and local tribute and enter audience.
translations.idiomatic: The privy council memorialized, "Acting Burma expedition branch secretariat commissioner Hesairihaiya reported that on reaching Burma, when he urged the king to come to court, the king said neighboring tribes had repeatedly rebelled and it was not easy to depart immediately; it was proposed to send Anadara to present a memorial and local tribute and enter audience.

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，太陰犯牽牛。

translations.literal: " On xinchou day the moon transgressed Niulang.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinchou day the moon transgressed Niulang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，熒惑犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On renyin day Mars transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Mars transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，雲南行省愛魯言，金齒酋打奔等兄弟求內附，且乞入覲。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Yunnan branch secretariat official Ailu reported that Jinchi chiefs Daben and his brothers sought to submit and also requested audience at court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Yunnan branch secretariat official Ailu reported that Jinchi chiefs Daben and his brothers sought to submit and also requested audience at court.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太陰犯司怪。

translations.literal: On renzi day the moon transgressed Siguai.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the moon transgressed Siguai.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，日暈連環，白虹貫之。

translations.literal: On guichou day the sun showed linked halos, and a white rainbow pierced through them.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the sun showed linked halos, and a white rainbow pierced through them.

sentences.zh: 罷乃顏所署益都、平灤，也不幹河間分地達魯花赤，及勝納合兒濟南分地所署官。

translations.literal: Officials appointed by Nayan — darughachi in Yidu and Pingluan, Yebogan in Hejian appanage, and officials in Jinan appanage under Shengnahe'er — were all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Officials appointed by Nayan — darughachi in Yidu and Pingluan, Yebogan in Hejian appanage, and officials in Jinan appanage under Shengnahe'er — were all dismissed.

sentences.zh: 移北京道按察司置豪州，免東京等處軍民徭賦。

translations.idiomatic: The Beijing surveillance commission moved its seat to Haozhou; corvée and taxes for troops and civilians in Dongjing and other places were remitted.

sentences.zh: 升福建鹽運使司，依兩淮等例，為都轉運使司。

translations.literal: The Fujian Salt Transport Commission was promoted, following the Two Huai precedent, to a Directorate of Salt Transport.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian salt transport commission was promoted, following the Two Huai precedent, to a directorate of salt transport.

sentences.zh: 以中興府隸甘州行省，以河西愛牙赤所部屯田軍同沙州居民修城河西瓜、沙等處。

translations.literal: Zhongxing Prefecture was placed under the Ganzhou Branch Secretariat; military colonists under Hexi prince Aiyachi together with Shazhou residents repaired city walls and riverworks in Xigua, Sha, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxing Prefecture was placed under the Ganzhou branch secretariat; military colonists under Hexi prince Aiyachi together with Shazhou residents repaired city walls and riverworks in Xigua, Sha, and other places.

sentences.zh: 立阇鄽屯田。

translations.literal: A military colony was established at Chetian.
translations.idiomatic: A military colony was established at Chetian.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，太白犯亢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, guihai day: Venus transgressed Kang.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, guihai day: Venus transgressed Kang.

sentences.zh: 浚州進瑞麥，一莖九穗。

translations.literal: Junzhou presented auspicious wheat, one stalk with nine ears.
translations.idiomatic: Junzhou presented auspicious wheat, one stalk with nine ears.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，車駕還上都。

translations.literal: On yichou day the imperial procession returned to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the imperial procession returned to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 以李海剌孫為征緬行省參政，將新附軍五千、探馬赤軍一千以行，仍調四川、湖廣行省軍五千赴之。

translations.literal: Li Hailasun was made associate administrator of the Burma expedition branch secretariat; he led five thousand newly submitted troops and one thousand tammaq on the expedition; five thousand troops from the Sichuan and Huguang branch secretariats were also mobilized to join.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hailasun was made associate administrator of the Burma expedition branch secretariat; he led 5,000 newly submitted troops and 1,000 tammaq on the expedition; 5,000 troops from the Sichuan and Huguang branch secretariats were also mobilized to join.

sentences.zh: 召能通白夷、金齒道路者張成及前占城軍總管劉全，並為招討使，佩虎符，從征。

translations.literal: Zhang Cheng, who knew the routes through the White Yi and Jinchi, and former Champa army commander Liu Quan were both summoned and made pacification commissioners, granted tiger tallies, and joined the expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cheng, who knew the routes through the White Yi and Jinchi, and former Champa army commander Liu Quan were both summoned and made pacification commissioners, granted tiger tallies, and joined the expedition.

sentences.zh: 以脫滿答兒為都元帥，將四川省兵五千赴緬省，仍令其省駐緬近地，以俟進止。

translations.literal: Tuomadai'er was made commander-in-chief, leading five thousand Sichuan troops to the Burma secretariat; the secretariat was also ordered to encamp near Burma and await further orders.
translations.idiomatic: Tuomadai'er was made commander-in-chief, leading 5,000 Sichuan troops to the Burma secretariat; the secretariat was also ordered to encamp near Burma and await further orders.

sentences.zh: 置江南四省交鈔提舉司。

translations.literal: Paper currency intendant offices for the four Jiangnan branch secretariats were established.
translations.idiomatic: Paper currency intendant offices for the four Jiangnan branch secretariats were established.

sentences.zh: 己巳，謫從叛諸王赴江南諸省從軍自效。

translations.literal: On jisi day princes who had followed the rebellion were banished to serve in the Jiangnan branch secretariats to redeem themselves through military service.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day princes who had followed the rebellion were banished to serve in the Jiangnan branch secretariats to redeem themselves through military service.

sentences.zh: 諭鎮南王脫歡，禁戢從征諸王及省官奧魯赤等，毋縱軍士焚掠，毋以交趾小國而易之。

translations.literal: Prince of Zhennan Tuohuan was instructed to restrain the campaign princes and provincial officials including olje'u, not to allow troops to burn and plunder, and not to treat the small state of Annam lightly.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Zhennan Tuohuan was instructed to restrain the campaign princes and provincial officials including olje'u, not to allow troops to burn and plunder, and not to treat the small state of Annam lightly.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，朵兒朵海獲叛王阿赤思，赦之。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Doreduohai captured rebel prince Achisi and pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Doreduohai captured rebel prince Achisi and pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 亦集乃路屯田總管忽都魯請疏浚管內河渠，從之。

translations.literal: Military colony commissioner Hudulu of Yijinai Route requested dredging of waterways within his jurisdiction; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Military colony commissioner Hudulu of Yijinai Route requested dredging of waterways within his jurisdiction; this was approved.

sentences.zh: 丙子，填星南犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Saturn transgressed Leibi Formation in the south.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Saturn transgressed Leibi Formation in the south.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太陰犯天關。

translations.literal: On jimao day the moon transgressed Tianguan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the moon transgressed Tianguan.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太陰犯東井。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太白犯房。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Venus transgressed Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Venus transgressed Fang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，沈州饑，又經乃顏叛兵蹂踐，免其今歲絲銀、租賦。

translations.literal: On dinghai day famine struck Shenzhou, which had also been trampled by Nayan's rebel troops; this year's silk, silver, and land taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day famine struck Shenzhou, which had also been trampled by Nayan's rebel troops; this year's silk, silver, and land taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 以北京伐木三千戶屯田平灤。

translations.literal: Three thousand logging households from Beijing were stationed for military colonization in Pingluan.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand logging households from Beijing were stationed for military colonization in Pingluan.

sentences.zh: 立豐贍、昌國、濟民三署，秩五品，設達魯花赤、令、丞、直長各一員。

translations.literal: Three offices — Fengshan, Changguo, and Jimin — were established at fifth rank, each with one darughachi, director, vice-director, and supervising clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Three offices — Fengshan, Changguo, and Jimin — were established at fifth rank, each with one darughachi, director, vice-director, and supervising clerk.

sentences.zh: 女人國貢海人。

translations.literal: The Women's Kingdom presented sea people.
translations.idiomatic: The Women's Kingdom presented sea people.

sentences.zh: 置河西務馬站。

translations.literal: A horse relay station was established at Hexi Station.
translations.idiomatic: A horse relay station was established at Hexi Station.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，東京義靜、麟、威遠、婆娑等處大霖雨，江水溢，沒民田；

translations.literal: Ninth month, on xinmao day, at Yijing, Lin, Weiyuan, Posa, and other places in Eastern Capital torrential rains fell; the river overflowed and inundated farmland;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinmao day, torrential rains at Yijing, Lin, Weiyuan, Posa, and other places in Eastern Capital made the river overflow and inundate farmland;

sentences.zh: 大定、金源、高州、武平、興中等處霜雹傷稼。

translations.literal: At Dading, Jinyuan, Gaozhou, Wuping, Xingzhong, and other places frost and hail damaged crops.
translations.idiomatic: At Dading, Jinyuan, Gaozhou, Wuping, Xingzhong, and other places frost and hail damaged crops.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，熒惑犯長垣。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Mars transgressed Changyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Mars transgressed Changyuan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，湖廣省臣言：「海南瓊州路安撫使陳仲達、南寧軍總管謝有奎、延欄總管苻庇成，以其私船百二十艘、黎兵千七百餘人，助征交趾。

translations.literal: On jihai day Hunan-Guangxi branch secretariat officials said: "Hainan Qiongzhou Route pacification commissioner Chen Zhongda, Nanning Army zongguan Xie Youkui, and Yanlan zongguan Fu Picheng, with their private ships numbering one hundred twenty and Li troops numbering more than one thousand seven hundred, assisted the campaign against Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Hunan-Guangxi branch secretariat officials said, "Hainan Qiongzhou Route pacification commissioner Chen Zhongda, Nanning Army zongguan Xie Youkui, and Yanlan zongguan Fu Picheng, with 120 private ships and more than 1,700 Li troops, had assisted the campaign against Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 」詔以仲達仍為安撫使，佩虎符，有奎、庇成亦仍為沿海管軍總管，佩金符。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Chen Zhongda remain pacification commissioner with tiger tally; Youkui and Picheng also remain coastal military zongguan with gold tallies.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered Chen Zhongda remain pacification commissioner with a tiger tally; Youkui and Picheng also remain coastal military zongguan with gold tallies.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太白犯天江。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Venus transgressed Tianjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Venus transgressed Tianjiang.

sentences.zh: 給諸王八八所部窮乏者鈔萬一千錠。

translations.literal: Paper currency of eleven thousand one hundred ingots was granted to the impoverished under Prince Baba's following.
translations.idiomatic: 11,100 ingots of paper currency were granted to the impoverished under Prince Baba's following.

sentences.zh: 禁市毒藥者。

translations.literal: Sale of poison was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Sale of poison was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 以西京、平灤路饑，禁酒。

translations.literal: Because the Western Capital and Pingluan Route suffered famine, wine was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Western Capital and Pingluan Route suffered famine, wine was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太陰犯畢。

translations.literal: On yisi day the moon transgressed Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the moon transgressed Bi.

sentences.zh: 以米二萬石、羊萬口給阿沙所統唐兀軍。

translations.literal: Twenty thousand shi of rice and ten thousand sheep were granted to the Tangut army under Asha.
translations.idiomatic: 20,000 shi of rice and 10,000 sheep were granted to the Tangut army under Asha.

sentences.zh: 丁未，安南國遣其中大夫阮文彥、通侍大夫黎仲謙貢方物。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the Kingdom of Annam dispatched its Central Grandee Ruan Wenyan and Attendant Grandee Li Zhongqian to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Kingdom of Annam dispatched Central Grandee Ruan Wenyan and Attendant Grandee Li Zhongqian to present local products.

translations.literal: On wushen day Xiancheng, Yizhou, and Northern Capital, because of Nayan's rebellion the people had abandoned farming and frost and hail had also struck, reported famine; an edict ordered fifty thousand shi of sea-transport grain to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Xiancheng, Yizhou, and Northern Capital, where Nayan's rebellion had left the people unable to farm and frost and hail had also struck, reported famine; an edict ordered 50,000 shi of sea-transport grain to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，熒惑犯太微西垣上將。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Mars transgressed the Taiwei Western Rampart Senior General.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Mars transgressed the Taiwei Western Rampart Senior General.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太白犯南斗。

translations.literal: On renzi day Venus transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Venus transgressed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 禁沮撓江南茶課。

translations.literal: Obstruction of the Jiangnan tea tax was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Obstruction of the Jiangnan tea tax was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 高麗王王春來朝。

translations.literal: King Wang Chun of Goryeo came to court.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo came to court.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the wuwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the wuwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太陰犯牽牛大星。

translations.literal: On renxu day the moon transgressed the great star of Niulang.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon transgressed the great star of Niulang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On jiazi day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 桑哥請賜葉李、馬紹、不忽木、高翥等鈔，詔賜李鈔百五十錠，不忽木、紹、翥各百錠。

translations.literal: Sangge requested grants of paper currency to Ye Li, Ma Shao, Buqumu, Gao Zhu, and others; an edict granted Li one hundred fifty ingots, and Buqumu, Shao, and Zhu each one hundred ingots.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge requested paper currency grants for Ye Li, Ma Shao, Buqumu, Gao Zhu, and others; an edict granted Li 150 ingots and Buqumu, Shao, and Zhu 100 ingots each.

sentences.zh: 又言：「中書省舊在大內前，阿合馬移置於北，請仍舊為宜。

translations.literal: He also said: "The Central Secretariat formerly stood before the Inner Palace; Ahmad moved it north; please restore it to its original site.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "The Central Secretariat formerly stood before the Inner Palace; Ahmad moved it north; please restore it to its original site.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

translations.literal: On guiyou day Jiangxi branch secretariat Yuedeshi said: "Guangdong is poor, remote, and dangerously distant — a haunt where bandits of Jiangxi and Fujian appear and vanish; I ask that ten thousand troops be divided from the Jiangnan provinces to reinforce my command.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Jiangxi branch secretariat Yuedeshi said, "Guangdong is poor, remote, and dangerously distant — a haunt where Jiangxi and Fujian bandits appear and vanish; I ask that 10,000 troops be divided from the Jiangnan provinces to reinforce my command.

sentences.zh: 」詔江西忽都帖木兒以軍五千付之。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Jiangxi's Hudutemur to give him five thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered Jiangxi's Hudutemur to give him 5,000 troops.

sentences.zh: 丙子，誅郭佑、楊居寬。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Guo You and Yang Jukuan were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Guo You and Yang Jukuan were executed.
