translations.literal: On wuyin day Sangge said: "The Prince of Beian's chancellor's office has no seal, yet the Prince of Anxi's chancellor alone has a seal — this is truly not precedent; please take it back.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Sangge said, "The Prince of Beian's chancellor's office has no seal, yet the Prince of Anxi's chancellor alone has a seal — this is truly not precedent; please take it back.

sentences.zh: 諸王勝納合兒印文曰『皇侄貴宗之寶』，寶非人臣所宜用，因其分地改為『濟南王印』為宜。

translations.literal: Prince Shengnahor's seal inscription reads 'Precious seal of the imperial nephew and honored clansman' — such a seal is not what a subject should use; according to his allotment it should be changed to 'Seal of the Prince of Jinan.'
translations.idiomatic: Prince Shengnahor's seal inscription reads 'Precious seal of the imperial nephew and honored clansman' — such a seal is not what a subject should use; according to his allotment it should be changed to 'Seal of the Prince of Jinan.'

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: " All were approved.

sentences.zh: 從總帥汪惟和言，分所部戍四川軍五千人屯田六盤。

translations.literal: Following commander-in-chief Wang Weihe's request, five thousand troops from his garrison in Sichuan were divided off to garrison-farm at Liupan.
translations.idiomatic: At commander-in-chief Wang Weihe's request, 5,000 troops from his Sichuan garrison were divided off to garrison-farm at Liupan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Mars transgressed Left Law.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Mars transgressed Left Law.

sentences.zh: 立陜西寶鈔提舉司。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi Precious Notes Intendancy was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Precious Notes Intendancy was established.

sentences.zh: 羅北甸土官火者、阿禾及維摩合剌孫之子並內附。

translations.literal: The native officials Huozhe and Ahe of Luobei dian and the son of Weimo Helasun all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The native officials Huozhe and Ahe of Luobei dian and the son of Weimo Helasun all submitted.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，範文虎言：「豪、懿、東京等處，人心未安，宜立省以撫綏之。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Fan Wenhu said: "At Hao, Yi, Eastern Capital, and other places the people's hearts are still unsettled; a branch secretariat should be established to pacify and reassure them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Fan Wenhu said, "At Hao, Yi, Eastern Capital, and other places the people's hearts are still unsettled; a branch secretariat should be established to pacify and reassure them.

sentences.zh: 」詔立遼陽等處行尚書省，以薛阇幹、阇裏帖木兒並行尚書省平章政事，洪茶丘右丞，亦兒撒合左丞，楊仁風、阿老瓦丁並參知政事。

translations.literal: " An edict established the Liaoyang Route Branch Secretariat; Xieshgan and Shelitemur were both made branch secretariat grand councillors, Hong Chachiu right vice councillor, Yiersahe left vice councillor, Yang Renfeng and Alaowading both associate administrators.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict established the Liaoyang Route branch secretariat; Xieshgan and Shelitemur were both made branch secretariat grand councillors, Hong Chachiu right vice councillor, Yiersahe left vice councillor, and Yang Renfeng and Alaowading associate administrators.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，太白犯壘壁陣，月暈金、土二星。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renchen day Venus transgressed Leibi Formation; the moon had a corona around Venus and Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renchen day Venus transgressed Leibi Formation, and the moon had a corona around Venus and Saturn.

sentences.zh: 雲南省右丞愛魯兵次交趾木兀門，其將昭文王以四萬人守之，愛魯擊破之，獲其將黎石、何英。

translations.literal: Yunnan branch secretariat right vice councillor Ailu's army halted at Muwumen in Jiaozhi; the Prince of Zhaowen defended it with forty thousand men; Ailu defeated them and captured generals Li Shi and He Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan branch secretariat right vice councillor Ailu's army halted at Muwumen in Jiaozhi; the Prince of Zhaowen defended it with 40,000 men; Ailu defeated them and captured generals Li Shi and He Ying.

sentences.zh: 弛太原、保德河魚禁。

translations.literal: The ban on river fishing at Taiyuan and Baode was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: The ban on river fishing at Taiyuan and Baode was lifted.

sentences.zh: 以桑哥為金紫光祿大夫、尚書右丞相，兼統制院使，領功德使司事。

translations.literal: Sangge was made Grand Master of the Golden Gate and Purple Radiance, right chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and concurrently controller of the Directorate and director of the Bureau of Meritorious Achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge was made Grand Master of the Golden Gate and Purple Radiance, right chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and concurrently controller of the directorate and director of the bureau of meritorious achievements.

sentences.zh: 從桑哥請，以平章帖木兒代其位，右丞阿剌渾撒裏升平章政事，葉李升右丞，參知政事馬紹升左丞。

translations.literal: At Sangge's request, Pingzhang Tiemur replaced his post; right vice councillor Alaghunsari was promoted to grand councillor; Ye Li was promoted to right vice councillor; associate administrator Ma Shao was promoted to left vice councillor.
translations.idiomatic: At Sangge's request, Pingzhang Tiemur replaced his post; right vice councillor Alaghunsari was promoted to grand councillor; Ye Li was promoted to right vice councillor; and associate administrator Ma Shao was promoted to left vice councillor.

sentences.zh: 升集賢院秩正二品。

translations.literal: The Academy of Scholarly Worthies was promoted to rank two正.
translations.idiomatic: The Academy of Scholarly Worthies was promoted to rank two正.

sentences.zh: 丙申，熒惑犯太微東垣上相。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Mars transgressed the Taiwei Eastern Rampart Senior Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Mars transgressed the Taiwei Eastern Rampart Senior Minister.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，桑哥言：「先是皇子忙哥剌封安西王，統河西、土番、四川諸處，置王相府，後封秦王，綰二金印。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Sangge said: "Previously Prince Manggalai was enfeoffed as Prince of Anxi, governing Hexi, Tibet, Sichuan, and other places, and a princely chancellor's office was established; later he was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin and held two gold seals.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Sangge said, "Previously Prince Manggalai was enfeoffed as Prince of Anxi, governing Hexi, Tibet, Sichuan, and other places, and a princely chancellor's office was established; later he was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin and held two gold seals.

sentences.zh: 今嗣王安難答仍襲安西王印，弟按攤不花別用秦王印，其下復以王傅印行，一藩而二王，恐於制非宜。

translations.literal: Now the successor Anandapati still inherits the Prince of Anxi seal, while his younger brother Antanbuhua separately uses the Prince of Qin seal; below them the tutor's seal is again employed in administration — one fief with two princes — this is likely improper in regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Now the successor Anandapati still inherits the Prince of Anxi seal, while his younger brother Antanbuhua separately uses the Prince of Qin seal; below them the tutor's seal is again employed in administration — one fief with two princes — likely improper in regulation.

sentences.zh: 」詔以阿難答嗣為安西王，仍置王傅，而上秦王印，按攤不花所署王傅罷之。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Anandapati succeed as Prince of Anxi with the princely tutor still appointed, the Prince of Qin seal submitted, and the princely tutor post held by Antanbuhua abolished.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered Anandapati succeed as Prince of Anxi with the princely tutor still appointed, the Prince of Qin seal submitted, and the princely tutor post held by Antanbuhua abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以別十八里漢軍及新附軍五百人屯田合迷玉速曲之地。

translations.literal: On wuxu day five hundred Han troops of Biebashibali and newly submitted troops were sent to garrison-farm at Hemiyusuqu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day 500 Han troops of Biebashibali and newly submitted troops were sent to garrison-farm at Hemiyusuqu.

sentences.zh: 己亥，鎮南王次思明，程鵬飛與奧魯赤等從鎮南王分道並進，阿八赤以萬人為前鋒。

translations.literal: On jihai day the Prince of Zhennan halted at Siming; Cheng Pengfei and Aoluchi and others advanced separately with the Prince of Zhennan; Abachi led ten thousand as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the Prince of Zhennan halted at Siming; Cheng Pengfei, Aoluchi, and others advanced separately with the Prince of Zhennan; Abachi led 10,000 as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 大都路水，賜今年田租十二萬九千一百八十石。

translations.literal: Dadu Route suffered flooding; this year's field rent of one hundred twenty-nine thousand one hundred eighty shi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Dadu Route suffered flooding; this year's field rent of 129,180 shi was remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，烏馬兒、樊楫及程鵬飛等遂趣交趾，所向克捷。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Umar, Fan Ji, and Cheng Pengfei and others then pressed toward Jiaozhi, succeeding everywhere they went.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Umar, Fan Ji, and Cheng Pengfei and others then pressed toward Jiaozhi, succeeding everywhere they went.

sentences.zh: 改衛尉院為太僕寺，秩三品，仍隸宣徽，以月赤徹兒、禿禿合領之。

translations.literal: The Court of the Imperial Stud was changed to the Grand Stud Court, rank three, still subordinate to the Palace Provisioner; Yuechi'er and Tutuhe were placed in charge.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of the Imperial Stud was changed to the Grand Stud Court, rank three, still subordinate to the palace provisioner; Yuechi'er and Tutuhe were placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鎮南王次界河，交趾發兵拒守，前鋒皆擊破之。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the Prince of Zhennan halted at Jiehe; Jiaozhi dispatched troops to resist and defend; the vanguard broke them all.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Prince of Zhennan halted at Jiehe; Jiaozhi dispatched troops to resist; the vanguard broke them all.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔議弭盜。

translations.literal: On jiyou day an edict ordered deliberation on suppressing banditry.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict ordered deliberation on suppressing banditry.

sentences.zh: 桑哥、玉速帖木兒言：「江南歸附十年，盜賊迄今未靖者，宜降旨立限招捕，而以安集責州縣之吏，其不能者黜之。

translations.literal: Sangge and Yusutemur said: "Jiangnan has been under allegiance ten years, yet bandits to this day have not been pacified; an edict should set a time limit for recruitment and capture, and settling the people should be the responsibility of prefecture and county officials — those who fail should be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge and Yusutemur said, "Jiangnan has been under allegiance ten years, yet bandits to this day have not been pacified; an edict should set a time limit for recruitment and capture, and settling the people should be the responsibility of prefecture and county officials — those who fail should be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 」葉李言：「臣在漳州十年，詳知其事，大抵軍官嗜利與賊通者，尤難弭息。

translations.literal: " Ye Li said: "I was in Zhangzhou ten years and know the matter in detail; generally military officers who crave profit and collude with bandits are especially hard to suppress.
translations.idiomatic: " Ye Li said, "I was in Zhangzhou ten years and know the matter in detail; generally military officers who crave profit and collude with bandits are especially hard to suppress.

sentences.zh: 宜令各處鎮守軍官，例以三年轉徙，庶革斯弊。

translations.literal: Each garrison commander should by regulation rotate every three years — then this abuse may be reformed.
translations.idiomatic: Each garrison commander should by regulation rotate every three years — then this abuse may be reformed.

sentences.zh: 」帝皆從其議，詔行之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor approved all their proposals, and an edict carried them out.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor approved all their proposals, and an edict carried them out.

sentences.zh: 封駙馬帖木兒濟寧郡王。

translations.literal: The imperial son-in-law Tiemur was enfeoffed as Prince of Jining Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial son-in-law Tiemur was enfeoffed as Prince of Jining Commandery.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以江西行省平章忽都帖木兒督捕廣東等處盜賊。

translations.literal: On renzi day Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Hudutemur was ordered to supervise capture of bandits in Guangdong and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Hudutemur was ordered to supervise capture of bandits in Guangdong and other places.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命京畿、濟寧兩漕運司分掌漕事。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the Dadu metropolitan and Jining grain transport commissions were ordered to divide grain transport duties between them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Dadu metropolitan and Jining grain transport commissions were ordered to divide grain transport duties between them.

sentences.zh: 鎮南王次萬劫，諸軍畢會。

translations.literal: The Prince of Zhennan halted at Wanjie; all armies assembled.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Zhennan halted at Wanjie; all armies assembled.

sentences.zh: 獲福建首賊張治囝，其黨皆平。

translations.literal: The chief bandit of Fujian, Zhang Zhijian, was captured; his partisans were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The chief bandit of Fujian, Zhang Zhijian, was captured; his partisans were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 諭江南四省招捕盜賊。

translations.literal: The four Jiangnan provinces were instructed to recruit and capture bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The four Jiangnan provinces were instructed to recruit and capture bandits.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，熒惑犯進賢。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Mars transgressed Jinxian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Mars transgressed Jinxian.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，立尚乘寺。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on guihai day, the Court of the Imperial Carriage was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guihai day, the Court of the Imperial Carriage was established.

sentences.zh: 順元宣慰使禿魯古言，金竹寨主搔驢等以所部百二十五寨內附。

translations.literal: Shunyuan pacification commissioner Tuluguyan and Jinzhu Stockade chief Saolü and others submitted with the one hundred twenty-five stockades under their command.
translations.idiomatic: Shunyuan pacification commissioner Tuluguyan and Jinzhu Stockade chief Saolü and others submitted with the 125 stockades under their command.

sentences.zh: 甲子，皇子北安王置王傅，凡軍需及本位諸事並以王傅領之。

translations.literal: On jiazi day a princely tutor was appointed for the imperial prince, the Prince of Beian; all military supplies and original-rank affairs were to be administered by the princely tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day a princely tutor was appointed for the imperial prince, the Prince of Beian; all military supplies and original-rank affairs were to be administered by the princely tutor.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太陰犯畢，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the moon transgressed Bi, and Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the moon transgressed Bi, and Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，減揚州省歲額米十五萬石，以鹽引五十萬易糧。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Yangzhou province's annual rice quota was reduced by one hundred fifty thousand shi; five hundred thousand salt certificates were used to exchange for grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Yangzhou province's annual rice quota was reduced by 150,000 shi; 500,000 salt certificates were used to exchange for grain.

sentences.zh: 免浙西魚課三千錠，聽民自漁。

translations.literal: The Zhexi fish tax of three thousand ingots was remitted, and the people were permitted to fish on their own.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhexi fish tax of 3,000 ingots was remitted, and the people were permitted to fish on their own.

sentences.zh: 發河西、甘肅等處富民千人往阇鄽地，與漢軍、新附軍雜居耕植。

translations.literal: One thousand wealthy households from Hexi, Gansu, and other places were dispatched to Chayan territory to live mixed with Han and newly submitted troops and cultivate.
translations.idiomatic: 1,000 wealthy households from Hexi, Gansu, and other places were dispatched to Chayan territory to live mixed with Han and newly submitted troops and cultivate.

sentences.zh: 從安西王阿難答請，設本位諸匠都總管府。

translations.literal: At Prince of Anxi Anandapati's request, a directorate general of original-rank artisans was established.
translations.idiomatic: At Prince of Anxi Anandapati's request, a directorate general of original-rank artisans was established.

sentences.zh: 升萬億庫官秩四品。

translations.literal: Officials of the Myriad Treasury were promoted to rank four.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Myriad Treasury were promoted to rank four.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，鎮南王次茅羅港，攻浮山寨，破之。

translations.literal: On guiyou day the Prince of Zhennan halted at Maoluo Harbor, attacked Fushan Stockade, and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Prince of Zhennan halted at Maoluo Harbor, attacked Fushan Stockade, and captured it.

sentences.zh: 諸王薛徹都等所駐之地，雨土七晝夜，羊畜死不可勝計，以鈔暨幣帛綿布雜給之，其直計鈔萬四百六十七錠。

translations.literal: At the places where Princes Xiechedu and others were stationed, soil rained for seven days and nights; sheep and livestock died beyond counting; paper currency together with silks, cotton cloth, and miscellaneous goods were granted as compensation, totaling ten thousand four hundred sixty-seven ingots of paper currency in value.
translations.idiomatic: At the places where Princes Xiechedu and others were stationed, soil rained for seven days and nights; sheep and livestock died beyond counting; paper currency together with silks, cotton cloth, and miscellaneous goods were granted as compensation, totaling 10,467 ingots of paper currency in value.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以朱清、張瑄海漕有勞，遙授宣慰使。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan, for meritorious service in sea-route grain transport, were remotely appointed pacification commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan, for meritorious service in sea-route grain transport, were remotely appointed pacification commissioners.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，鎮南王以諸軍渡富良江，次交趾城下，敗其守兵，日烜與其子棄城走敢喃堡。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the Prince of Zhennan led the armies across the Fu River, halted below the Jiaozhi city, defeated its garrison troops; Ri Xuan and his son abandoned the city and fled to Gannan Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Prince of Zhennan led the armies across the Fu River, halted below the Jiaozhi city, and defeated its garrison troops; Ri Xuan and his son abandoned the city and fled to Gannan Fort.

sentences.zh: 是歲，命西僧監臧宛卜卜思哥等作佛事坐靜於大殿、寢殿、萬壽山、五臺山等寺，凡三十三會。

translations.literal: That year, Tibetan monks including Jianzang Wanbubusi were ordered to conduct Buddhist rites in seated meditation at the Great Hall, Sleeping Hall, Wanshou Mountain, Wutai Mountain, and other temples — thirty-three assemblies in all.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tibetan monks including Jianzang Wanbubusi were ordered to conduct Buddhist rites in seated meditation at the Great Hall, Sleeping Hall, Wanshou Mountain, Wutai Mountain, and other temples — 33 assemblies in all.

sentences.zh: 斷天下死刑百二十一人。

translations.literal: Capital sentences throughout the realm numbered one hundred twenty-one persons.
translations.idiomatic: 121 persons were sentenced to death throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 浙西諸路水，免今年田租十之二；

translations.literal: The Zhexi routes suffered floods; two-tenths of this year's field rent was remitted;
translations.idiomatic: The Zhexi routes suffered floods; two-tenths of this year's field rent was remitted;

sentences.zh: 西京、北京、隆興、平灤、南陽、懷孟等路風雹害稼；

translations.literal: The Western Capital, Northern Capital, Longxing, Pingluan, Nanyang, Huaimeng, and other routes suffered wind and hail damaging crops;
translations.idiomatic: The Western Capital, Northern Capital, Longxing, Pingluan, Nanyang, Huaimeng, and other routes suffered wind and hail damaging crops;

sentences.zh: 保定、太原、河間、般陽、順德、南京、真定、河南等路霖雨害稼，太原尤甚，屋壞壓死者眾；

translations.literal: Baoding, Taiyuan, Hejian, Panyang, Shunde, Nanjing, Zhending, Henan, and other routes suffered torrential rains damaging crops; Taiyuan was especially severe, with many killed as houses collapsed;
translations.idiomatic: Baoding, Taiyuan, Hejian, Panyang, Shunde, Nanjing, Zhending, Henan, and other routes suffered torrential rains damaging crops; Taiyuan was especially severe, with many killed as houses collapsed;

sentences.zh: 平陽春旱，二麥枯死，秋種不入土；

translations.literal: Pingyang suffered spring drought; the second crop withered and died; autumn seed did not enter the soil;
translations.idiomatic: Pingyang suffered spring drought; the second crop withered and died; autumn seed did not enter the soil;

sentences.zh: 鞏昌雨雹，虸蚄為災。

translations.literal: Gongchang suffered hail; locust larvae became a disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchang suffered hail; locust larvae became a disaster.

sentences.zh: 分賜皇子、諸王、駙馬、怯薛帶等羊馬鈔，總二十五萬三千五百餘錠，又賜諸王、怯薛帶等軍人，馬一萬二千二百、羊二萬二千六百、駝百餘。

translations.literal: Sheep, horses, and paper currency were distributed in shares to imperial princes, princes, imperial sons-in-law, keshik retainers, and others, totaling more than two hundred fifty-three thousand five hundred ingots; military men among princes and keshik retainers were also granted twelve thousand two hundred horses, twenty-two thousand six hundred sheep, and more than one hundred camels.
translations.idiomatic: Sheep, horses, and paper currency were distributed in shares to imperial princes, princes, imperial sons-in-law, keshik retainers, and others, totaling more than 253,500 ingots; military men among princes and keshik retainers also received 12,200 horses, 22,600 sheep, and more than 100 camels.

sentences.zh: 賑貧乏者合剌忽答等鈔四萬八千二百五十錠。

translations.literal: Paper currency of forty-eight thousand two hundred fifty ingots was granted to relieve the impoverished including Qalaghuqa and others.
translations.idiomatic: 48,250 ingots of paper currency were granted to relieve the impoverished including Qalaghuqa and others.
